entry.title: Linear Least Squares as a Frozen Baseline
entry.summary: Ordinary least squares recovers a linear map from noisy observations. This fixture exists so Wave A tests never contact the network.

entry.title: Majority Class Baselines on Imbalanced Holdouts
entry.summary: A majority class predictor is hard to beat when the feature carries no signal about the label. Reported gains over such a baseline are often split artefacts.

entry.title: Citation Distance and the Reuse of Nearby Methods
entry.summary: Methods reused within two citation hops tend to repeat the assumptions of the seed paper. Distant paths are harder to inspect but less likely to inherit those assumptions.
